summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the nomination of Dr. Lykke Hinsch Gylvin to its Board of Directors, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or other special situation event is described. The filing pertains to a routine corporate governance matter—a board nomination—and does not trigger any deal mechanics or capital markets event. The registrant reports this news as a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K, which is equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for disclosure of material events. No deal terms apply.
